method: Independent controlled DOM/runtime seams; no native or gameplay proof

checks.name: Real wrapper applies a hit only to positive health loss inside a successful emission
Direct damage outside emission cannot create a hit receipt
Throwing emitter restores scoped collector before later direct damage and emissions
Changing world during an emitter cannot leave a receipt in the replacement scene
Changing save owner during an emitter cannot credit replacement save
Actual incoming health loss is measured and menu opening clears transient feedback
Replacing world during incoming damage cannot retain its damage receipt
Scene epoch and weapon changes clear existing damage/hit/reload records
Actual final adjusted reload duration drives progress and cancellation clears total
Expired hit and hurt receipts are hidden after the presentation clock advances
